about: Section names that open a section of a parliamentary document, lower case, as printed at the start of a short line; the number is how often each was found. Built from the working set on 6 October 2026; grows with every find. The names under response announce the answer to a submission within the same document, in German, French and Italian; they hold for every parliament alike, and what stands under such a heading becomes the response of the document. Set on 11 October 2026 by the assistant, open; a name added here counts from the next run on.
